name: Soft Edge Wipe
paragraphs: A linear wipe transition with an adjustable feathered edge, used for transitioning between two layers of footage with a subtle blend. Soft Edge Wipe includes angle control and the ability to add a colored stroke as a part of the transition.

Universe Dashboard presets for Soft Edge Wipe make A-B linear transitions smooth, simple, and easy to set up. Just keyframe the Mix duration (see below) and tune to taste! Find these presets via the blue Open Dashboard... button or the Choose a Preset... button below it.
As with all other Universe tools, you can modify or create a Soft Edge Wipe look and then save it under its own name by pressing the Save Preset... button.
